title: CommerceEvent
description: The canonical OmniRec event, envelope version 2. Generated by `omnirec generate` from catalog/envelope/v2.schema.json and the catalog blocks. Event names are open: standard names come from the catalog and custom names from a tracking plan, so `event` is checked by pattern here and by the event registry at runtime. Per-event required fields are enforced by the validator, not by this schema. Version 1 is frozen at schema/v1/commerce-event.schema.json.

eventId.description: Unique per event. The deduplication key — a repeated eventId is delivered once.

event.description: Event name. Standard names are listed in x-omnirec-standard-events; aliases of older names are accepted and rewritten.

eventVersion.description: Version of this event's definition in the catalog or plan.

kind.description: Set server-side from the registry. A client-supplied value is ignored.

schemaVersion.description: Envelope version. Bumped only on a breaking change.

source.description: Which kind of producer sent the event.

timestamp.description: Client capture time. Clamped server-side if implausibly skewed; see receivedAt for the authoritative server time.

tenantId.description: Set server-side from the authenticated API key. A value supplied by the client is ignored.

identity.description: Never merged in place. An event captured anonymously keeps its null userId forever; the anonymousId -> userId association lives separately as an identity link.

anonymousId.description: First-party device identity. Never an IP address and never a fingerprint.

userId.description: Merchant's own customer id. Supplied via identify(); the SDK never invents one.

sessionId.description: Current browsing session. New session after the configured inactivity timeout (default 30 minutes) or on logout.

context.description: Where the event happened. ip and country are server-derived and overwrite whatever the client sent.

ip.description: Server-derived only. Dropped unless retain-ip-address is enabled.

campaign.description: Marketing attribution parsed from the landing URL. Persisted for the session.

clickId.description: gclid, fbclid, msclkid or ttclid value.

type.description: Page kind declared by the storefront, for example home, product, category, cart.

data.description: The event's payload, grouped into blocks from the catalog. Inline fields declared by a tracking plan sit beside the blocks.

properties.description: Free-form merchant attributes. Payment credentials, passwords, and secrets are rejected here by name at any depth — see docs/security.md.

unplanned.description: Set server-side in permissive mode when the event is in neither the catalog nor the tenant's plan.

receivedAt.description: Stamped by the Event API on receipt. Server-owned; a client-supplied value is ignored.
